card.name: Lewoz
card.tagline: Warrior gwoka rhythm and the night drum gathering.
card.profile: Lewoz is one of the seven base gwoka rhythms - a combative/warrior rhythm in two-time, historically said to have set the rhythm for attacks on plantations and to function as an incantation dance, marked by a strong dialogue between dancer and make. The word also names the traditional night gathering (the lewoz / sware lewoz), held traditionally on Friday or Saturday until dawn, where participants form the lawonn circle around the ka drums, chacha and singers; dancers enter one by one to face the drums while the crowd claps and sings the response (Wikipedia; BNF France Ameriques).
card.insight: Lewoz is considered the reference rhythm and the preferred space of expression of gwoka; the English Wikipedia entity describes the lewoz event/performance tradition (rural musical performances of Martinique and Guadeloupe, as opposed to gwo ka moderne) rather than narrowly the rhythm.
